[SWS_CM_90109] SecOC secure channel for events using reliable transport
⌈
A SecOC secure channel shall be created and used if:
• A SecOcSecureComProps instance is referenced in the role secureCom-
PropsForTcp by a ServiceInstanceToMachineMapping and an event
of the AdaptivePlatformServiceInstance is selected for transmission over the secured channel by the ServiceInterfaceElementSecureCom-
Config and this event of the AdaptivePlatformServiceInstance is con-
figured for transmission over “tcp” by transportProtocol in the associated
SomeipEventDeployment.
⌋
